question: Which city does Alfred Hoffmann live in?
Which companies does Mahinda Perera work at?
Which country has the most people living in it?
gold: MATCH (:Person)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(:City)-[:IS_PART_OF]->(k:Country) RETURN k.name, count(*) AS n ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many people live in the United States?
Which forum has the most members?
gold: MATCH (f:Forum)-[:HAS_MEMBER]->(:Person) RETURN f.title, count(*) AS n ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

question: At which university do the largest number of Alfred Hoffmann's friends study?
gold: MATCH (:Person {firstName:'Alfred', lastName:'Hoffmann'})-[:KNOWS]-(f:Person)-[:STUDY_AT]->(u:University) RETURN u.name, count(DISTINCT f) AS n ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many people are friends of friends of Mahinda Perera, not counting Mahinda Perera or Mahinda Perera's direct friends?
gold: MATCH (p:Person {firstName:'Mahinda', lastName:'Perera'})-[:KNOWS*2]-(x:Person) WHERE x <> p AND NOT (p)-[:KNOWS]-(x) RETURN count(DISTINCT x)

question: What is the length of the shortest friendship path between Alfred Hoffmann and Mahinda Perera?
gold: MATCH (a:Person {firstName:'Alfred', lastName:'Hoffmann'}), (b:Person {firstName:'Mahinda', lastName:'Perera'}) MATCH p = shortestPath((a)-[:KNOWS*]-(b)) RETURN length(p)

question: How many posts did Anupam Reddy create in 2011?
Who created the most posts tagged with Muammar Gaddafi in 2011?
gold: MATCH (:Tag {name:'Muammar_Gaddafi'})<-[:HAS_TAG]-(m:Post)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person) WHERE m.creationDate.year = 2011 RETURN p.firstName, p.lastName, count(m) AS n ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1
